facts.text: Jolene's pet snake named Seraphim slinked out of its cage and coiled up next to her while she was playing video games.

evidence.quote: I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it.

facts.text: Jolene purchased her pet snake Seraphim one year prior to the session date.

evidence.quote: I bought it a year ago in Paris.

facts.text: Jolene's pet snake named Seraphim is described as having sly eyes in a photo.
Jolene's pet snake named Seraphim was previously referred to as 'Susie' in an earlier conversation.
